name: Eniri
source:
A witch respected in the big city and beyond, she is Shar's host and the mistress of her mansion. She can't help herself from conducting dangerous experiments. Strict and merciless toward those she sees as inferior, she will try to teach Shar her views about life, social roles and magic.

[From [url=https://www.rollingcrown.com/ice_demon/]official website[/url]]
